pages.title: Batch Processing
pages.text: Barrel recipes combine an item ingredient with a required fluid amount and may require the barrel to be sealed. JEI displays the configured item count for every valid item or tag alternative.

pages.title: Reading JEI
pages.text: When an ingredient is a tag, JEI rotates through valid alternatives without changing the required quantity. Fluid tags similarly show compatible fluids at the amount required by the recipe.
